curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with how much driving depends on sight and how vision shrinks after dark, then staying within headlight reach, the night stopping table at twenty, forty, sixty and seventy miles per hour on low beams, other night rules, and when headlights must be on.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards that separate the stopping distances at each speed and the headlight times versus the wiper law.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the night stopping distances and the headlight rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach crosswalk right of way, scanning twelve seconds ahead and what that means on a city street, slowing in heavy traffic, approaching intersections and uncontrolled intersections, then speed as a crash factor, open highways, warning signs and animals on the road.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the scanning rule versus its city-block example and for controlled versus uncontrolled intersections.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on crosswalks, scanning ahead, intersections and highway hazards.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show the doubled fines in New Jersey construction zones, how far ahead a work zone is announced, detours versus diversions, the work zone basics and distractions to avoid, where a work zone ends, and the national crash figures.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for detours versus diversions and for the start of a work zone versus its end.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on work zone warnings, fines, routing and safe behavior.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the ignition key and steering lock, what causes skids and how to steer out of a rear-wheel skid, then planned emergency stops on paved and unpaved shoulders, warning devices and signalling for help, and recovering when the wheels drift off the pavement.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for steering into a skid versus turning sharply away, and for a planned shoulder stop versus drifting off the pavement.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps skid steps, shoulder-stop steps and the drift-off recovery.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what to do in a car fire, how long a vehicle floats and the best way out of a vehicle in water, seat belts, windows and doors in water, then a stall on railroad tracks and how to run if a train is coming.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for float time versus escape time and for a stall with no train versus a train approaching.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on fire, water escape and railroad track emergencies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through brake failure and the parking brake, flats and blowouts, an engine that dies, a stuck gas pedal, a hood that flies up, headlights that go dark and wipers that quit.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for brake failure versus a blowout and for headlight failure versus wiper failure.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the response to each vehicle failure.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Present the three choices of stopping, turning or speeding up, braking with antilock versus conventional brakes, turning without braking, when to speed up, and what to hit if a crash cannot be avoided.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for antilock versus conventional brakes and for speeding up versus stopping.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on the three choices, braking methods and choosing what to hit.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach how to protect yourself from head-on, rear-end and side crashes, then the duty to notify police, hitting a parked vehicle, what to do at any crash scene, the written MVC report and when it is not needed.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for head-on with versus without restraints and for the police report versus the written MVC report.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on crash-type protection and the reporting duties after a crash.
